title: Simple and Effective Masked Diffusion Language Models

openAccessPdf.disclaimer: Notice: Paper or abstract available at https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.07524, which is subject to the license by the author or copyright owner provided with this content. Please go to the source to verify the license and copyright information for your use.

tldr.text: An effective training recipe is applied that improves the performance of masked diffusion models and a simplified, Rao-Blackwellized objective is derived that can be used to train encoder-only language models that admit efficient samplers.
